Driver.title: Driver
Driver.description: Information about a delivery driver, their current location, and status.

avatar.description: URL to the driver's avatar image

isOnline.description: Whether the driver is currently active

heading.description: Direction the driver is heading in degrees

status.description: Current status of the driver's delivery work

lastUpdate.description: Unix timestamp of the last update

proofOfDelivery.description: URL to recorded proof of delivery image

signature.description: Base64 or text representation of merchant signature

CargoItem.title: Cargo Item
CargoItem.description: An item being delivered within a driver's cargo manifest.

Merchant.title: Merchant
Merchant.description: A merchant or business in the logistics network.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A real-time message between drivers and dispatchers.

chatId.description: The ID of the chat (Driver ID)

/drivers/{driverId}/cargo/{itemId}.description: The current cargo manifest for a specific driver.

/chats/{driverId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Private chat between a driver and the dispatchers.
